```{python setup}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
import sys
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

sys.path.append(os.path.abspath('src/etl'))
import aws_processing
from datetime import datetime
from dateutil.relativedelta import relativedelta

DATA_DIR      = "data/raw/infrastructure/AWS_Costs/"
DATAVERSE_DIR = "data/raw/infrastructure/"
charge_dir    = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, 'aws-charges')

df_history = aws_processing.process_aws_data(DATA_DIR)

end_date   = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-01')
start_date = (datetime.now() - relativedelta(months=12)).strftime('%Y-%m-01')

try:
    df_live = aws_processing.fetch_aws_costs(start_date, end_date)
    if df_live.empty:
        df_aws = df_history
    else:
        live_start = pd.to_datetime(start_date)
        df_history_filtered = df_history[df_history['date'] < live_start]
        df_aws = pd.concat([df_history_filtered, df_live], ignore_index=True)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Live AWS fetch failed ({e}). Falling back to CSV only.")
    df_aws = df_history

df_ledger       = aws_processing.extract_ledger_costs(charge_dir)
df_s3           = aws_processing.fetch_s3_storage_stats()
df_potree_growth = aws_processing.fetch_s3_historical_growth('potree-test2', days=365)

def print_markdown_table(headers, rows):
    table_str = "\n| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |\n"
    table_str += "| " + " | ".join(["---"] * len(headers)) + " |\n"
    for row in rows:
        table_str += "| " + " | ".join([str(c) for c in row]) + " |\n"
    display(Markdown(table_str))
```

```{python kpis}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

def fmt(n):
    try:
        return f"{int(n):,}"
    except Exception:
        return "—"

# Dataverse: latest published row
kpi_datasets = kpi_files = kpi_downloads = kpi_dv_date = '—'
try:
    _dv = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATAVERSE_DIR, 'datasets_files_published_monthly.csv'))
    _dv['date'] = pd.to_datetime(_dv['date'], format='%Y-%m')
    _latest = _dv.sort_values('date').iloc[-1]
    kpi_datasets  = fmt(_latest.get('datasets_published', 0))
    kpi_files     = fmt(_latest.get('files_published', 0))
    kpi_downloads = fmt(_latest.get('downloads', 0))
    kpi_dv_date   = str(_latest['date'])[:7]
except Exception:
    pass

# AWS: most recent month total cost
if not df_aws.empty:
    _recent = df_aws['date'].max()
    kpi_aws       = f"${df_aws[df_aws['date'] == _recent]['cost'].sum():,.0f}"
    kpi_aws_month = _recent.strftime('%b %Y')
else:
    kpi_aws = '—'; kpi_aws_month = '—'

print(f"""
<div class="kpi-row grid">
  <div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3 kpi-card">
    <span class="kpi-label">Dataverse Datasets</span>
    <span class="kpi-value">{kpi_datasets}</span>
    <span class="kpi-note">Cumulative published, as of {kpi_dv_date}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3 kpi-card">
    <span class="kpi-label">Dataverse Files</span>
    <span class="kpi-value">{kpi_files}</span>
    <span class="kpi-note">Cumulative published</span>
  </div>
  <div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3 kpi-card">
    <span class="kpi-label">Total Downloads</span>
    <span class="kpi-value">{kpi_downloads}</span>
    <span class="kpi-note">Cumulative file-level download events</span>
  </div>
  <div class="g-col-6 g-col-md-3 kpi-card">
    <span class="kpi-label">AWS Spend</span>
    <span class="kpi-value">{kpi_aws}</span>
    <span class="kpi-note">{kpi_aws_month} estimate; billing lags ~1–2 mo.</span>
  </div>
</div>
""")
```

## AWS Costs

### Monthly Departmental Charges (Ledger)

```{python ledger}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if not df_ledger.empty:
    table_data = [
        [r['month'], f"${r['ledger_cost']:,.2f}"]
        for _, r in df_ledger.sort_values('month', ascending=False).iterrows()
    ]
    print_markdown_table(["Month", "Actual Cost Charged"], table_data)
else:
    print("No ledger data found.")
```

### Monthly Trends

```{python aws_trends}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Stacked bar chart showing monthly AWS costs by application over the past 12 months."
if not df_aws.empty:
    df_aws['month_label'] = df_aws['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    monthly = df_aws.groupby(['month_label', 'application'])['cost'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
    monthly.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, colormap='tab10', figsize=(10, 5))
    plt.legend(title='Application', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
    plt.title('Monthly AWS Costs')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

## Dataverse Usage

### Repository Growth (Cumulative)

```{python dv_growth}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Dual-axis line chart showing cumulative growth of UCLA Dataverse datasets (left axis, blue) and files (right axis, gold) over time."
try:
    df_dv = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATAVERSE_DIR, 'datasets_files_published_monthly.csv'))
    df_dv['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_dv['date'], format='%Y-%m')

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

    ax1.plot(df_dv['date'], df_dv['datasets_published'],
             label='Total Datasets', color='#2774AE', linewidth=3)
    ax1.set_ylabel('Total Datasets', color='#2774AE', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2774AE')

    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.plot(df_dv['date'], df_dv['files_published'],
             label='Total Files', color='#FFD100', linewidth=3)
    ax2.set_ylabel('Total Files', color='#8B6F00', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#8B6F00')

    ax1.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: format(int(x), ',')))
    ax2.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: format(int(x), ',')))

    plt.title('UCLA Dataverse Cumulative Growth', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Dataverse data missing: {e}")
```

### Monthly Activity

```{python dv_monthly}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Two-panel chart. Top: bar and line chart of new datasets and files added per month over the last 24 months. Bottom: bar chart of monthly download volume."
try:
    df_dv['month_new_datasets'] = df_dv['datasets_published'].diff().fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_dv['month_new_files']    = df_dv['files_published'].diff().fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
    df_dv['month_downloads']    = df_dv['downloads'].diff().fillna(0).clip(lower=0)

    df_recent = df_dv.tail(24)

    fig, (ax1, ax3) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 10), sharex=True)

    ax1.bar(df_recent['date'], df_recent['month_new_datasets'],
            color='#2774AE', alpha=0.6, width=20, label='New Datasets')
    ax1.set_ylabel('New Datasets', color='#2774AE', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.set_ylim(bottom=0)

    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.plot(df_recent['date'], df_recent['month_new_files'],
             color='#FFD100', marker='o', linewidth=2, label='New Files')
    ax2.set_ylabel('New Files', color='#8B6F00', fontweight='bold')
    ax2.set_ylim(bottom=0)

    ax1.set_title('Monthly Publication Activity (Last 24 Months)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
    ax1.legend(loc='upper left')
    ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

    ax3.bar(df_recent['date'], df_recent['month_downloads'],
            color='#2ca02c', alpha=0.6, width=20)
    ax3.set_ylabel('Monthly Downloads', color='#2ca02c', fontweight='bold')
    ax3.set_ylim(bottom=0)
    ax3.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: format(int(x), ',')))
    ax3.set_title('Monthly Download Volume', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

    plt.xticks(rotation=45)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error calculating monthly activity: {e}")
```

## S3 Storage

### Current Bucket Sizes

```{python s3_sizes}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if not df_s3.empty:
    table_data = [
        [r['bucket'], f"{r['size_gb']:.2f} GB", r['last_updated'].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')]
        for _, r in df_s3.sort_values('size_gb', ascending=False).iterrows()
    ]
    print_markdown_table(["Bucket Name", "Size (GB)", "Last Updated"], table_data)
else:
    print("S3 storage data unavailable (live AWS connection required).")
```

### Potree Storage Growth

```{python potree}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Line chart with shaded area showing Potree S3 bucket storage growth in gigabytes over the last 365 days."
if not df_potree_growth.empty:
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    plt.plot(df_potree_growth['date'], df_potree_growth['size_gb'],
             color='#1f77b4', linewidth=3)
    plt.fill_between(df_potree_growth['date'], df_potree_growth['size_gb'],
                     color='#1f77b4', alpha=0.1)
    plt.title('Potree Storage Growth (GB, Last 365 Days)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    plt.ylabel('Size (GB)', fontweight='bold')
    plt.ylim(bottom=0)
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    plt.show()
else:
    print("Potree growth data unavailable (CloudWatch reports this metric once daily).")
```

:::

---

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" .data-notes title="Data notes"}
- **AWS costs**: Cost Explorer API (last 12 months) merged with historical CSV exports. Most recent 1–2 months are estimates; final billing may differ
- **Dataverse datasets/files/downloads**: Cumulative counts from the UCLA Dataverse `/api/info/metrics` endpoint — stored in `data/raw/infrastructure/datasets_files_published_monthly.csv`
- **Downloads**: File-level events as reported by Dataverse. Includes automated and bot traffic; not filtered for human-only access
- **S3 storage**: Fetched live from AWS CloudWatch at render time. May be unavailable without valid AWS credentials; CloudWatch reports storage metrics once daily
- Full rules: [Metrics Governance](metrics-governance.md) · [About](about.qmd)
:::
